oilCapacity.appliesTo: 2.4L 4-cylinder (K24W) only in this market; 2WD and AWD share the same fill.

oilViscosity.value: Genuine Honda Motor Oil 0W-20 or API Premium-grade 0W-20 detergent oil

batteryGroup.note: this edition prints no battery reserve-capacity or BCI group number

tpmsReset.value: Press and hold the TPMS button until the low tire pressure/TPMS indicator blinks twice to start calibration; it then finishes automatically after about 30 minutes of cumulative driving at 30-60 mph.

tires.note: Compact spare: T155/90D17 101M at 60 psi. Pressures are cold inflation pressures.
